messages:
sara: Quick sync from the postmortem — we need an actionable list for GPU capacity + autoscale followups. I sketched priorities, please react with ownership and ETA.

morgan: I can own scheduler tuning items. Will prioritize: 1) scale-down imbalance, 2) pod preemption thresholds. ETA: EOD Thu for initial config proposal.

sasha: I'll take the quota requests with cloud. Filed request RDW-4523 (GCP gpu-quota bump to 120 -> 200) — ticket link: https://tickets.redwood/4523. Expect approval window ~3 business days.

alex: I'll own headroom planning and runbook updates. Propose setting conservative headroom at 18% for peak windows for next 2 weeks while autoscale changes roll out.

tia: I can help validate Private deployment implications (VPC routing + KMS). Will check if any quota bump affects dedicated pools. ETA Fri AM.

ops-bot: Deploy started by @morgan for branch scheduler/tune-2026 at 2024-02-10T16:12:09Z — rolling 3 nodes.

sara: Thanks. Two important cross-cutting items: A) we need a small canary and circuit for clients when capacity drops (fallback to lower-cost model). B) set an alert for sustained queue depth > 50 for 10m.

morgan: For the canary we can use model-routing policy 'fallback-min' in router v2. I will add a canary rule and a gradual rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%).

sasha: If quota RDW-4523 stalls, is there a soft-fallback we can use? maybe temporary throttling per-tenant or deny large-batch requests.

alex: Yes — we can enable per-API-key throttles in the console for bursty customers; I'll draft thresholds. Also adding a short-circuit that prefers quantized variants (int8) when GPU headroom < 12%.

sara: Nice. Please add short descriptions for each action item with owner, acceptance criteria, and a timeline. I'll collate into the postmortem followups doc.

morgan: Action: scheduler tuning PR with metrics baseline. Owner: morgan. Acceptance: 10% reduction in spike-induced evictions on staging + no latency regressions >5th percentile. ETA: Thu EOD.

sasha: Action: quota request RDW-4523 + fallback throttle config. Owner: sasha. Acceptance: quota approved or throttle applied + runbook updated. ETA: 3 business days for approval, throttle done by Wed.

alex: Action: headroom policy and runbook update (quantization fallback). Owner: alex. Acceptance: runbook + console flag in prod, measured headroom adherence over 1 week. ETA: Fri.

tia: Action: Private/Dedicated verification. Owner: tia. Acceptance: confirm no VPC issues with proposed autoscale and quota changes. ETA: Fri AM.

sara: I'll schedule a 30m check-in next Tue 09:30 PT to review progress, owners should post brief status in this thread beforehand. If any item slips, ping me and we'll re-prioritize.

morgan: Quick note: here's the tuning snippet I'll start from:

```
autoscaler:
  scale_up_threshold: 0.65
  scale_down_threshold: 0.25
  max_batch_size: 64
  preempt_protected: true
```

morgan: I'll run experiments on staging traffic replay and post graphs here.

sasha: Cloud updated me — quota request created and awaiting quota team. I attached the usage spreadsheet. If approved, schedule for next maintenance window.

alex: I'm going to add a small eval to monitor quality delta when switching to int8 for common prompts. Acceptance requires <2% drop in task-level intent accuracy.

sara: Also capturing recurring incident pattern: surges on Tue afternoons driven by batch jobs from partner X. Action: reach out to partner X to stagger large retrain/import jobs off-peak. Owner: sara. ETA: today.

tia: Confirmed dedicated pools won't hit KMS rate limits with quantized rollouts — ran a quick test. No blockers.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly remediation radar meeting scheduled every Tue 09:30 PT.

sara: Perfect. I'll turn these into entries in the postmortem tracker with IDs so we can reference them in future incidents. Thanks team — drop updates here as you make progress. :rocket:
